boundaries.name: ring-lwe-hardness
boundaries.obligation: The security of the scheme rests on Ring-LWE/uSVP hardness at n = 2048, q = BabyBear, ternary secret and CBD(2) noise; the model states no secrecy property and the core-SVP cost table in the source is not reproduced or checked.

boundaries.name: upstream-regev-plonky3
boundaries.obligation: regev_plonky3::keygen / encrypt / decrypt / encode_value_message, the negacyclic NTT and the field type F are opaque; that they implement the ring arithmetic, that decryption inverts encryption, and that the upstream message encoder produces the modelled 64-bit little-endian layout are undischarged premises (DecryptsTo, HomomorphicDigits and the encodeAmount definition).

boundaries.name: rng-and-noise-distribution
boundaries.obligation: The caller-supplied cryptographic RNG, the ternary secret sampler and the CBD(2) noise sampler are boundaries: the model neither samples nor bounds actual noise, and TernarySecret is an asserted shape, not a derived property of channel_keygen.

boundaries.name: keccak-and-poseidon-binding
boundaries.obligation: solidity_keccak256 / hash_words and PoseidonHashOut::hash_inputs_u64 are opaque; the model produces the exact word streams only. Collision resistance, the Bytes32 encoding, and 'equal digest implies equal key/ciphertext' are not proved.

boundaries.name: panic-vs-error
boundaries.obligation: digest() / poseidon_digest() assert canonicality and panic; the model returns none instead. That every ingestion boundary validates before reaching them, so the panic is unreachable, is a caller obligation outside these files.

boundaries.name: noise-budget-arithmetic
boundaries.obligation: cbdWorstCaseNoise restates the source's worst-case comment 64*(4n+2) < Delta/2 as arithmetic over the pinned constants; it is not a probabilistic or worst-case bound on the noise actually accumulated by add_ciphertexts.

boundaries.name: homomorphic-add-enforcement
boundaries.obligation: MAX_HOMO_ADDS_BEFORE_REFRESH is only a constant here; that the per-member pending_adds counter is actually incremented and checked by the state-update circuits, and that a refresh happens before the budget is exhausted, is proved nowhere in this module.

boundaries.name: rust-machine-and-serde
boundaries.obligation: Refinement of the Nat/Int model to Rust u32/u64/u128/i8 arithmetic, casts, Vec indexing, serde Serialize/Deserialize wire formats and the dropped String error payloads is not established.

boundaries.name: decryption-gadget-agreement
boundaries.obligation: Constant and word-stream agreement is proved against Zkp.Implementation.DecryptionGadget, itself a handwritten model of the in-circuit gadget; agreement between either model and the compiled Rust/plonky2 code is not established.
